title: DNF junta size bound
statement: For a natural number $w$ and a real number $\varepsilon$, define the DNF junta size bound to be $1+\frac{(2w)^3}{\varepsilon^2}9^d$, where $d$ is the DNF Friedgut degree for $w$ and $\varepsilon$.
